shortDescription: Recopilates the facts of the listening ports of the machine

options.name: date_uformat
options.description: The format of the date when the process that owns the port started. The date specification is UFormat

options.name: tcp_filter
options.description: Filter for the state of the TCP ports that will be recopilated. Supports multiple states (Bound, Closed, CloseWait, Closing, DeleteTCB, Established, FinWait1, FinWait2, LastAck, Listen, SynReceived, SynSent and TimeWait), that can be used alone or combined. Note that the Bound state is only available on PowerShell version 4.0 or later.
